Hi Emily — thanks for the file and the heads-up. We're on it. Quick answers up front:
- We'll correlate your export with runtime metrics and model variant rollouts to rule out infra-driven regressions.
- Fast levers: tweak batching to improve tokens-per-batch (typical ~15–25% cost reduction), enable prefix/KV cache warmups for recurring patient contexts, and switch non-latency-critical summarization jobs to our quantized variant.
- Temporary capacity: we can provision a 30–90 day Dedicated burst pool; lead time is generally 7–14 days depending on size.

I'm looping Rishi (AE) and Grace (CS) to cover contract and ops detail. Thu 8/17 10:00 AM PT works for a 30-min slot — does that fit you and Procurement?

Emily / team — thanks for the sync today. Recap + next steps below. I've attached the proposal addendum and a one-page cost runbook.

Recap (what we observed)
- Spike correlates with an increase in concurrent summarization jobs after a new ingest pipeline went live on 7/29. No runtime regression or kernel change detected on Redwood's side.
- Current cadence would exhaust your committed runway in ~6 weeks if sustained at today's peak levels.

Short-term levers (estimated impact)
- Batching increase (agg request window): ~18% token cost reduction, negligible latency impact for batch-friendly jobs.
- Prefix/KV cache pre-warm: ~9% effective token reduction on repeated patient contexts, improves tail latency consistency.
- Quantized model variant for non-clinical/archival summaries: ~30% token cost reduction with modest latency variance; recommend gating to background jobs only.

Commercial options
- 60-day Dedicated burst pool (proposal_capacity_addendum_v2.pdf): available with 7-day lead time; includes onboarding support and a capped monthly uplift to avoid unpredictable overages.
- Short-term credit: one-time usage credit to cover transition spikes if you sign the addendum by EOD Fri 8/25.

Requested inputs from LumenHealth
- Which job classes can tolerate quantized variants vs. which require strict low-latency clinical SLAs.
- Procurement PO template (Emily indicated Net 45).

Next steps
- We'll provision a trial config for batching + cache warmups in your staging environment by Tue 8/23.
- Rishi to share the DocuSign link for the addendum and the addendum PDF (attached).
- Emily to confirm job-class mapping and send PO template.

Attachments: proposal_capacity_addendum_v2.pdf, lumen_monthly_usage_aug2028.csv

Thanks — happy to jump back on a quick call if helpful.
